_about: Opinion marks (relationship overhaul Phase 1, DIRECTOR_BIBLE 5.170; the Council phase adds the staff and council marks: a council member's loyalty is his opinion of his senior coach, keyed s:<id>). v: opinion points (of 100) the mark is worth when it lands; fade: points it loses each round towards 0 (0 = it stays); tag: what kind of moment it is (a temperament scales by tag); why: the reason as the profile shows it, no full stop; scar: a long-tail mark (fades half a point a round or less). Read by scripts/sim/Opinion.gd; checked by Opinion.check_defs. Sizes are proposals: balance is the director's call.

dropped_star.why: Left out while fit, as one of our best

dropped_final.why: Left out of a final while fit

picked_final.why: Picked to play in a final

promise_kept.why: You kept your word to him

promise_broken.why: You broke your word to him

saw_promise_broken.why: You broke your word to a teammate

rival_picked.why: His rival for the spot was picked ahead of him

rival_traded.why: His rival for the spot was traded away

agenda_served.why: The club is going the way wanted

agenda_crossed.why: The club is not going the way wanted

faction_heard.why: You heard out the group he stands with

faction_rebuffed.why: You knocked back the group he stands with

faction_split.why: You broke up the group he stood with

ambition_met.why: He got what he wanted this season

ambition_soured.why: He did not get what he wanted this season

advice_passed_over.why: You took the other side's advice

advice_both_overruled.why: You went your own way over the advice

won_back.why: You went out of your way to win him back
